parts.tooltip: The final continuation: the parameter of the returned Cont. It says what to do with b once everything is done, and is supplied when the Cont is run, not when bind is called.
Builds the new continuation k' = \\a -> f a k.\nWhen k' receives a, it runs f a and hands it the ORIGINAL continuation k — this is the Cont-specific join.
Run the original computation, handing it k' instead of k. It decides if and when to call k' (once, many times, or never — callCC, early exit).
Abstract over k again: the whole body becomes the Cont r b that bind returns.

ports.tooltip: Cont r a = (a ⟶ r) ⟶ r — a suspended computation waiting for its continuation
f : a ⟶ Cont r b — user code; given result a, builds the next continuation-based step
Cont r b = (b ⟶ r) ⟶ r — the composed computation; callCC can capture k here for early exit
